verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R8 is not supported by the model, as the relationship between Play and Participant is defined as 1..*..1..* which implies a one-to-many relationship in both directions.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Change the relationship between Play and Participant to 1..*..0..* to allow multiple participants per play and multiple plays per participant.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R11 is not supported by the model, as the relationship between Play and Theater is defined as 0..*..1 which implies that a play can be in zero or one theater.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Change the relationship between Play and Theater to 1..*..0..* to allow a play to be in multiple theaters.
